Combo.name: Combo
Combo.description: Blossom Barrage: Spring Sorrow marks the target for 10 seconds, or 15 seconds from T3. The applier's Vernal Umbrella Ballistic skills deal 10% more damage to it; T1 raises this to 25%, and from T4 it is 30% while the target is Exhausted.

LingeringBone.name: Lingering Bone
LingeringBone.description: Peak's Springless Silence and Forsaken Fame mark a non-player target for 2 seconds. Unfading Flower's floating umbrella fires an extra shot each volley against it, and Peak's Springless Silence grants Windrider on hitting it.
